# openproject-thematiq

> An OpenProject plugin (Ruby gem, Rails engine) that gives OpenProject the same shell as a Nextcloud themed with thematiq: one token set, one top bar, project menu, buttons, inputs and tables. It works on its own and ships its design systems inside the plugin.

Start with AGENTS.md for the commands. Everything runs in Docker on the pinned image openproject/openproject:17.9.1.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): setup, build, test and quality commands, conventions
- [README.md](README.md): what the plugin does, installation, usage, running it in production
- [docs/development.md](docs/development.md): build and run the development image, where each part of the code lives
- [docs/tokens.md](docs/tokens.md): what a design system is and how its tokens reach the CSS
- [docs/catalogue.md](docs/catalogue.md): the bundled design systems and their file format
- [docs/admin-page.md](docs/admin-page.md): the administration page
- [docs/shell-structure.md](docs/shell-structure.md): the shared top bar and project menu
- [docs/geometry.md](docs/geometry.md): the sizes and spacing layer and its rules
- [docs/uploads.md](docs/uploads.md): uploaded logos, icons and fonts
- [docs/figma.md](docs/figma.md): download for Figma and upload from Figma
- [docs/testing/e2e.md](docs/testing/e2e.md): the Playwright end-to-end suite
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): changes per version

## API

- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): the read endpoints under /thematiq/api/v1/, the public shell-tokens answer and the setup endpoint for a sharing instance
- [config/routes.rb](config/routes.rb): every route of the plugin

## Decisions

- [docs/adr/README.md](docs/adr/README.md): numbered architecture decision records
- [docs/design/](docs/design/): the longer design notes they come from
